description: This Java class defines a SearchResponse model used in a search feature, containing properties like totalCount, entryCount, list of SearchEntry objects, and facets, along with their getters and setters.

classes.name: SearchResponse
classes.description: A data model representing the response of a search operation, including total results, current entries, and facets used for filtering.

methods.name: setTotalCount
methods.description: Sets the total number of entries available in the search results.

methods.name: getTotalCount
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of entries available in the search results.

methods.name: setEntryCount
methods.description: Sets the number of entries returned in the current search response.

methods.name: getEntryCount
methods.description: Retrieves the number of entries returned in the current search response.

methods.name: setEntries
methods.description: Sets the list of search entries contained in the response.

methods.name: getEntries
methods.description: Returns the list of search entries in the response.

methods.name: setFacets
methods.description: Sets the facets map used for filtering or categorization in the search results.

methods.name: getFacets
methods.description: Returns the facets map for the current search response.
